+# Coupled contacts and complete conditional price
+
+The endpoint is `kappa = 304153/100000000 = .00304153`, improving Ali
+Romman's PR5545 endpoint `.00304117` by `9/25000000 = .00000036`.
+Source head: `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`.
+The selected record is unchanged. All five framework premises remain:
+native all-column implementation, owned erasure, uniform compiler,
+precision and tape costs, and analytic recovery. This proves an ideal
+operator change and a complete conditional price; the enormous uniform
+word and rounded integer multiplier are not materialized.
+
+## Literal change and all-width implication
+
+`construct.py` pins these six zero-based source events:
+
+| Event | Unchanged scalar operation | Old frame | New frame |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 10461 | `297 += 303` | 335 | 17 |
+| 10462 | `303 -= 297/2` | 335 | 17 |
+| 13970 | `152 -= 297/2` | 335 | 17 |
+| 15479 | `198 += 319` | 915 | 207 |
+| 15639 | `205 += 198` | 915 | 207 |
+| 15640 | `198 -= 205/2` | 915 | 207 |
+
+Frame 335 has dimension two. Frame 17 is `span(145)`, dimension one.
+Frame 915 has dimension seven. Frame 207 has dimension eight and basis
+`[2,5,8,17,33,65,129,257]`. All are existing source canonical charts.
+No new coordinate transformation is granted for free.
+
+The emitter issues every nested MOVE needed to place both operands at
+the declared common frame. SCALE occurs at its operand's current frame;
+terminal public MOVEs finish at the original exits. Fifteen SCALE chart
+annotations change; every scalar coefficient and its order is retained.
+INIT/COPY/CLEAR lifetimes are unchanged. Every actual intervening source
+read and write is included in the complete replay. The word has 25,310 events.
+
+The separate [peer proof](peer/PROOF.md) and
+[role histories](peer/RECEIPT.json) bind the actual field versions. In the
+first group, role 297 coalesces two rank-one rises into rank two; role 303
+splits rank two into two rank-one rises; role 152 replaces two rank-two
+rises by ranks one and three. Their net delta is `H1 - 2H2 + H3`.
+In the second group, role 198 replaces ranks four plus one by rank five;
+role 319 exchanges the order of ranks one and two with zero profile delta;
+role 205 splits rank two into two rank-one rises. The net delta is
+`H1 - H2 - H4 + H5`.
+
+Let Phi_F be the exact canonical source chart. At field width f, a role
+stores Phi_F tensor-power f applied to its logical value. A MOVE F to G
+applies `Phi_G Phi_F^{-1}` tensor-power f, preserving that logical value.
+Same-chart ADD/COPY acts on logical values with its scalar applied once,
+outside tensor powers. SCALE commutes with transport by linearity. Thus
+the unchanged scalar/owned word and fixed endpoint charts imply exactly
+the same complete physical operator at every positive f. This is a
+compositional induction: no sum is tensor-powered and no width-one
+linear-independence claim is used.
+
+Three exact endpoint checks cover all 743 rows and 552,049 coefficients:
+sparse rational forward rows, dense integer reverse columns with binary
+denominators, and an independently written integer/dyadic peer interpreter
+that imports neither constructor nor native checker. All 735 public inputs
+remain arbitrary. All 527 productive helpers retain their targets. Eight
+owned lifetimes retain peak occupancy one and the original erasure premise.
+
+The source native compiler freshly lowers every MOVE, helper boundary and
+main adapter. Its separate Gaussian interpreter compares every signed Pauli
+image and absolute global phase: 2,979 distinct maps, 1,054 helper normalizers
+and 208 main adapters. Wrong phase is rejected. These exact base identities
+tensor to every positive f. The unchanged complete caller is freshly checked
+through its Laurent identity, 265-axis phase polynomial, 104 ports, both
+orientations and actual orthogonal routes. This algebraic check is distinct
+from materializing exponential-size all-column matrices.
+
+## Complete moment and transfer
+
+The new local paid profile is
+
+```text
+{1:2430, 2:554, 3:390, 4:111, 5:108, 6:17, 7:13, 9:1}.
+```
+
+Its delta from PR5545 is
+
+```text
+local:     +2H1 -3H2 +H3 -H4 +H5
+complete: +36H1 -54H2 +18H3 -18H4 +18H5
+target:    zero at every rank.
+```
+
+For `H_r=r^t`, `0<t<1`, strict concavity gives
+`H3-H2 < H2-H1` and `H5-H4 < H2-H1`. Summing shows the paid delta is
+strictly negative throughout this interval. Call count and rank mass are
+unchanged. This is different from repeating PR5545's `H1+H5 -> H6` edit
+and lies outside PR5548's narrow repetition ceiling.
+
+Each invocation retains helper targets `{4:51,5:36,7:24,8:122,9:294}`.
+The full bill includes 18 forward invocations, 15 genuine queries, 15 whole
+idles and 32 main banks: 69,912 paid calls, 12,814 productive fields and rank
+surplus 760. Maximum paid/target ranks remain 72/145. No helper is omitted.
+
+`pricing.py` retains PR5544/5545's funding argument. New mathematical
+parameters are claimed/tested saving and comparison endpoint; its input
+histogram comes from the freshly replayed word. Two independent full
+invoice counts and both inherited rational moment engines must agree.
+The strict raw crossing enclosure is
+
+```text
+.00304153116714 < raw crossing < .00304153116715.
+```
+
+The separate funding peer implements a third rational interval engine:
+50-term atanh logarithms with rigorous tails and 128-bit outward grids,
+followed by alternating exponential bounds of degrees 15/14. It imports
+neither retained moment engine. Its four sign enclosures and full invoice
+recount agree. The wrapper binds the audited word, source and complete
+receipt to this publication.
+
+Tested saving is `.0030415305`. Cutoff 17, floor 18, tail offset 1/5,
+power 1024, reserve `10^-10` and logarithm power 1000 fund completion,
+splitting and rounding. Compiler gap is `1/14000000000`, integer height
+`H=690116000000000`, test exponent 49,294; the preceding integer point
+fails. Ordinary/admitted BIT stock checks and all 54 strict plus four
+functional outer predicates pass. `RESULT.json` records exact rationals.
+The endpoint gain is not claimed to equal the raw-crossing difference,
+which has different safety margins. No global optimum is claimed.
+
+Scalar coefficients and counts are unchanged. The 26,000-event bound,
+per-event scalar growth below `2^16`, total local Gaussian rank 5,894 and
+owned peak one still bound reordered prefixes. Local native ranks stay
+at most nine. Routing, normalization, COPY, caller and erasure allowances
+are recomputed; no precision/tape cost is set to zero. The same five
+framework premises remain necessary.
+
+## Controls, source retention and credit
+
+The verifier rejects an old-chart contact, wrong butterfly coefficient,
+changed source event and uncharged recursive call. The peer also rejects
+missing owned CLEAR. Inherited checks reject missing central translation,
+wrong native phase, adverse completion cutoff and inadequate BIT saving.
+All 33 dependency files are authenticated before imports. The closed
+official export retains the exact PR5545 bytes and source attribution.
+
+Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
+These are author-side checks, not independent human/proof-kernel acceptance.
+Credit Ali Romman for PR5544/5545's caller and price; Gareth Davidson for
+PR2305; David Arias for PR2152; Cinna Davis for PR2219/controller; Jacob
+Alan Sussman for productive recursion; zxv for compiler/outer machinery;
+Cao Yifan for pricing; and all geometry, common-chart, dual-ADD, native,
+COPY, precision and analytic predecessors in the retained proofs. The
+new contribution is this coupled literal itinerary and conditional gain.

research/p104-joint-contact/SEARCH.md.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+# Discovery scope
+
+The search treats each ADD/COPY as a common-frame vertex. Consecutive
+touches on a public field impose increasing-subspace edges; owned fields
+impose decreasing-subspace edges. Public endpoint frames are fixed.
+SCALE commutes with transport and keeps its scalar chronology. The objective
+is the sum of `abs(dim(F)-dim(G))^(1-.00304117)` over actual transport edges.
+
+Single-vertex relabels and whole equal-frame-component relabels did not
+improve this source. A coupled expansion to one proposed frame allows an
+arbitrary subset of vertices to move together. For each edge this is a
+binary submodular cost: finite costs satisfy the triangle inequality for
+the rank-distance power; illegal subspace orders are forbidden. A minimum
+cut proposes the subset. The first sweep found the two changes retained
+here; a second sweep over this fixed candidate list found no further gain.
+
+The candidate list contained the 1,027 source frames and 96 additional
+join/intersection extrema of equal-frame components. Both successful moves
+use original frames17 and207. No new general optimization algorithm,
+global optimum or barrier to other frame/scalar/caller changes is claimed.
+Floating arithmetic selected candidates only. The submitted witness is
+reconstructed directly from six exact source sites, then checked with exact
+scalar/native/phase arithmetic and three rational moment engines.
+
+The reusable result here is the explicit changed itinerary and complete
+conditional price, not an assertion that this bounded search exhausts P104.

+"""Authenticate and open the retained Git-free PR5545 source closure.
+
+Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
+"""
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from hashlib import sha256
+from io import BytesIO
+from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
+import gzip,importlib.util,json,sys,tarfile,tempfile
+
+HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+def need(ok,why):
+    if not ok:
+        raise ValueError(why)
+
+@contextmanager
+def supplier():
+    pins=json.loads((HERE/'SOURCES.json').read_bytes())['retained_source']
+    path=HERE/'inputs'/Path(pins['path']).name
+    raw=path.read_bytes()
+    need(sha256(raw).hexdigest()==pins['sha256'],'Retained PR5545 capsule byte pin')
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='p104-joint-contact-')as tmp:
+        root=Path(tmp)
+        with tarfile.open(fileobj=BytesIO(gzip.decompress(raw)),mode='r:')as archive:
+            members=archive.getmembers()
+            names=[m.name for m in members]
+            need(len(names)==len(set(names)),'Unique retained source paths')
+            for member in members:
+                name=PurePosixPath(member.name)
+                need(member.isfile()and not name.is_absolute()and '..'not in name.parts,'Regular retained source path')
+                target=root/member.name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+                target.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(member).read())
+        manifest_raw=(root/'.research-export.json').read_bytes()
+        need(sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest()==pins['export_manifest_sha256'],'Exact official export inventory')
+        manifest=json.loads(manifest_raw)
+        need(manifest['commit']==pins['commit']and manifest['package']=='research/p104-full-frame-contact','Exact predecessor head and package')
+        need(len(manifest['files'])==pins['files']==33,'Full predecessor closure')
+        need(set(names)=={'.research-export.json'}|{r['path']for r in manifest['files']},'No omitted or extra dependency')
+        for row in manifest['files']:
+            raw=(root/row['path']).read_bytes()
+            need(len(raw)==row['size']and sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],'Source file '+row['path'])
+        source=root/'research/p104-productive-controller'
+        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('local',source/'local.py')
+        L=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules['local']=L;spec.loader.exec_module(L)
+        C=L.load(source/'caller.py','p104_joint_caller')
+        R=L.load(root/'research/p104-full-frame-contact/construct.py','p104_joint_predecessor')
+        yield root,L,C,R

@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+"""Six source-pinned ADD contact changes on Ali Romman's PR5545 word.
+
+Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
+The P104 supplier and controller retain their predecessor attribution.
+"""
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+EDITS = {
+    10461: (['ADD',297,303,'1',335],17),
+    10462: (['ADD',303,297,'-1/2',335],17),
+    13970: (['ADD',152,297,'-1/2',335],17),
+    15479: (['ADD',198,319,'1',915],207),
+    15639: (['ADD',205,198,'1',915],207),
+    15640: (['ADD',198,205,'-1/2',915],207),
+}
+
+def need(ok,why):
+    if not ok:
+        raise ValueError(why)
+
+def span(basis):
+    out={0}
+    for v in basis:
+        need(v not in out,'Independent frame basis')
+        out|={x^v for x in tuple(out)}
+    return frozenset(out)
+
+def construct(source):
+    need(len(source['program'])==25310 and len(source['frames'])==1027,'Pinned source dimensions')
+    for i,(expected,_) in EDITS.items():
+        need(source['program'][i]==expected,'Exact source ADD at '+str(i))
+    frames=[span(b)for b in source['frames']]
+    current=list(source['initial'])+[None]*8
+    out=[]
+    def move(r,b):
+        a=current[r]
+        if a==b:
+            return
+        need(a is not None,'Initialized operand')
+        need(frames[b]<frames[a]if r>=735 else frames[a]<frames[b],'Nested retimed transport')
+        out.append(['MOVE',r,a,b,r>=735]);current[r]=b
+    for i,e in enumerate(source['program']):
+        op,r=e[:2]
+        if op=='MOVE':
+            continue
+        if op=='INIT':
+            need(current[r]is None,'Fresh owned lifetime')
+            out.append(list(e));current[r]=e[2]
+        elif op=='CLEAR':
+            need(current[r]==e[2],'Owned chronology unchanged')
+            out.append(list(e));current[r]=None
+        elif op=='SCALE':
+            out.append([*e[:-1],current[r]])
+        else:
+            need(op in ('ADD','COPY'),'Scalar opcode')
+            f=EDITS[i][1]if i in EDITS else e[-1]
+            for s in e[1:3]:
+                move(s,f)
+            out.append([*e[:-1],f])
+    for r,f in enumerate(source['final']):
+        move(r,f)
+    word=deepcopy(source);word['program']=out
+    signature=lambda w:[e[:-1]for e in w['program']if e[0]!='MOVE']
+    need(signature(word)==signature(source),'Every scalar/owned coefficient and order retained')
+    need(len(out)==25310,'Fixed complete word length')
+    return word

+"""Complete mixed-target price, compiler and outer transfer.
+
+The interval and compiler bounds follow zxv and Cao Yifan. The productive
+recursion is by Jacob Alan Sussman. The controller is by Cinna Davis.
+Adapted from Ali Romman's PR5544/5545 for the two coupled contact changes.
+Successor choices prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
+Ali Romman's complete caller/price proof and all predecessor credit are retained.
+Apache-2.0.
+"""
+from collections import Counter
+from fractions import Fraction as Q
+import local as L
+
+KAPPA, TESTED = Q('.00304153'), Q('.0030415305')
+PREVIOUS = Q('.00304117')
+
+
+def encode(x):
+    if isinstance(x,Q):
+        return str(x)
+    if isinstance(x,dict):
+        return {str(k):encode(v) for k,v in x.items()}
+    if isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):
+        return [encode(v) for v in x]
+    return x
+
+
+def assemble(local, native, word, physical):
+    paid, targets = Counter(), Counter()
+    counts = Counter()
+    L.need(local['helpers'] == native['helpers'], 'Every productive helper has a native target')
+    for e in word['physical_events']:
+        counts[e[0]] += 1
+        if e[0] == 'LOCAL':
+            L.need(e[3] is False, 'Every source invocation is forward')
+            paid.update(local['paid'])
+            targets.update(local['helpers'])
+        elif e[0] == 'QUERY_SHEAR':
+            paid[1] += 104
+        elif e[0] == 'IDLE':
+            paid[8*len(e[2])] += 208
+    main = Counter()
+    idle = Counter({8*len(e[2]):0 for e in word['physical_events'] if e[0] == 'IDLE'})
+    for e in word['physical_events']:
+        if e[0] == 'IDLE':
+            idle[8*len(e[2])] += 208
+    L.need(idle == physical['whole_idle_jobs'], 'Every whole idle has a native Gaussian and full rank')
+    for term in word['diagonal']:
+        main[1+8*sum(term[1:])] += 104
+    L.need(main == physical['main_targets'], 'Every main target has its full native phase')
+    targets.update(main)
+    L.need(counts['LOCAL'] == 18 and counts['QUERY_SHEAR'] == counts['IDLE'] == 15, 'Complete call census')
+    # Recount by the two path lengths, without using emitted main diagonals.
+    second_t = Counter({r:18*n for r,n in local['helpers'].items()})
+    second_p = Counter({r:18*n for r,n in local['paid'].items()})
+    second_t[145] += 208
+    second_p[1] += 15*104
+    for length in (7,8):
+        for j in range(1,length+1):
+            second_t[1+8*(j+1)] += 208
+            second_p[8*(j+1)] += 208
+    L.need((targets,paid) == (second_t,second_p), 'Independent full invoice')
+    L.need(max(targets) == 145 and max(paid) == 72, 'Maximum recursive ranks')
+    L.need(sum(targets.values()) == 12814 and sum(paid.values()) == 69912, 'Complete field and call counts')
+    L.need(sum(r*n for r,n in targets.items())-sum(r*n for r,n in paid.items()) == 760, 'Complete rank surplus')
+    return targets,paid,counts
+
+
+def run(local,native,word,physical):
+    T,P,counts = assemble(local,native,word,physical)
+    E = L.load(L.ROOT/'research/higher-moment-strictification/verify.py','p104_productive_intervals')
+    other = L.load(L.ROOT/'research/kappa-rebuild/architecture/mixed_target_probe.py','p104_productive_second_intervals')
+    def margin(k):
+        a,b = E.moment(T,1-k), E.moment(P,1-k)
+        return a[0]-b[1],a[1]-b[0]
+    lo,hi,grid = 0,10**12,10**14
+    while hi-lo > 1:
+        m=(lo+hi)//2
+        if margin(Q(m,grid))[0] > 0:
+            lo=m
+        else:
+            hi=m
+    lower,upper = Q(lo,grid),Q(hi,grid)
+    L.need(margin(lower)[0] > 0 and margin(upper)[1] < 0, 'Strict rational crossing enclosure')
+    L.need(PREVIOUS < KAPPA < TESTED < lower and margin(PREVIOUS)[0] > 0, 'Changed complete bill improves selected kappa')
+    t,u,v,c,b = 1-TESTED,Q(1,5),1024,17,18
+    target,paid = E.moment(T,t),E.moment(P,t)
+    tl,th = other.moment(T,TESTED)
+    pl,ph = other.moment(P,TESTED)
+    L.need(tl > ph and max(tl,target[0]) <= min(th,target[1]) and max(pl,paid[0]) <= min(ph,paid[1]), 'Two exact moment engines')
+    alpha = E.divide(paid,target)
+    gamma = E.divide(E.moment(P,t+u),E.mul(E.power(c,u),target))
+    delta = E.divide((Q(sum(T.values())*b),)*2,E.mul(E.power(c,TESTED),target))
+    reserve,decay = Q(1,10**10),Q(97,100)
+    L.need(alpha[1] < 1-reserve and gamma[1] < decay and delta[1] < decay, 'All three charged tail ratios')
+    L.need(decay**128 < Q(1,16), 'Both tail decay blocks')
+    normalized = 1/(1+v*reserve)+Q(4,2**32)
+    L.need(normalized < 1 and c**64 < b**63, 'Full completion, splitting and rounding charges')
+    theta,power = Q(63,64),1000
+    eta = E.scale(E.power(145,-v*TESTED),t)
+    L.need(2*(c**v)**64 <= (145**v)**63 and eta[0] > theta**power, 'Shifted exits and complement capacity')
+    L.need(E.power(145,v*TESTED)[1] < 2**power, 'Compiler initial range')
+    gap = (TESTED-KAPPA)/7
+    L.need(gap.numerator == 1, 'Exact compiler integer grid')
+    step = gap.denominator
+    def wins(j):
+        return (step*j+1)**power < 2**j
+    left,right=1,2
+    while not wins(right):
+        left,right=right,2*right
+    while right-left > 1:
+        m=(left+right)//2
+        if wins(m):
+            right=m
+        else:
+            left=m
+    H=step*right
+    L.need(H > 8*v and wins(right) and not wins(right-1), 'Finite uniform threshold with predecessor rejection')
+    local_routes = (sum(local['paid'].values())+native['helper_normalizers']+native['main_adapters']+4*104+4*local['owned_lifetimes'])*1000
+    L.need(local['real_scalar_allowance']+local_routes < 10**7, 'Every local scalar, route and owned operation is funded')
+    boundary = sum(len(word['boundaries'][side+'_program']) for side in ('left','right'))
+    raw = 18*10**7 + 15*1664 + 32*104*(len(word['physical_events'])+boundary)
+    raw += 32*104*(26+1000)
+    L.need(raw < 10**9, 'Complete nonrecursive raw bound')
+    bit = L.read(L.ROOT/'research/query-thinned-controllers/RESULT.json')['ordinary_BIT']
+    atom = Q(bit['atom'])
+    ordinary=(1-atom)*Q(bit['after_cover'])+atom*Q('.0000384599')
+    admitted=Q(bit['admitted'])
+    L.need(atom > ordinary > admitted > TESTED and atom < 1-ordinary, 'Retained BIT admission and stock')
+    outer_module=L.load(L.ROOT/'research/pr4359-p7-padding/dependencies/compiler-refill/endpoint.py','p104_productive_outer')
+    params={'kappa':KAPPA,'tested_saving':TESTED,'complex_uniform_saving':KAPPA+6*gap,
+            'b':KAPPA+5*gap,'a':KAPPA+4*gap,'q':KAPPA+3*gap,'bit_saving':admitted,
+            'epsilon':1-gap,'beta':1-3*gap,'r0':gap/10,'stop':gap,'layout':gap,'d':gap}
+    outer=outer_module.ledger(params)
+    outer['functional_checks']['actual_new_BIT_stock_sublinear']=params['beta']*(1-atom)
+    L.need(len(outer['strict_checks']) == 54 and len(outer['functional_checks']) == 4, 'Complete outer predicate inventory')
+    L.need(all(x > 0 for key in ('strict_checks','functional_checks') for x in outer[key].values()), 'All outer inequalities strict')
+    wrong_cutoff = E.divide((Q(sum(T.values())*21),)*2,E.mul(E.power(20,TESTED),target))
+    L.need(wrong_cutoff[0] > 1, 'Old cutoff fails with this helper inventory')
+    bad=outer_module.ledger(dict(params,bit_saving=Q('.0027')))
+    L.need(any(x <= 0 for x in bad['strict_checks'].values()), 'Insufficient BIT contract rejected')
+    return encode({'kappa':KAPPA,'kappa_decimal':'.00304153','previous_open_pr5545':PREVIOUS,'gain':KAPPA-PREVIOUS,
+                   'relative_gain_percent':100*(KAPPA/PREVIOUS-1),'raw_root_interval':[lower,upper],
+                   'raw_headroom':[lower-KAPPA,upper-KAPPA],'margin_at_previous':E.display(margin(PREVIOUS)),
+                   'targets':T,'paid':P,'productive_fields':sum(T.values()),'paid_calls':sum(P.values()),
+                   'rank_mass_surplus':760,'full_forward_calls':18,'query_shears':15,'whole_idle_jobs':3120,
+                   'strictification':{'tested':TESTED,'power':v,'cutoff':c,'floor':b,'tail_offset':u,'reserve':reserve,
+                                     'alpha':E.display(alpha),'gamma':E.display(gamma),'delta':E.display(delta),'normalized_paid_upper':normalized},
+                   'compiler':{'theta':theta,'logarithm_power':power,'eta':E.display(eta),'gap':gap,'H':H,'N':'2^'+str(H),
+                               'integer_test_exponent':right,'uniform_saving':params['complex_uniform_saving'],'word_materialized':False},

+                                   'raw_scalar_upper':raw,'raw_budget':10**9,'peak_owned_fields':1,
+                                   'fixed_scalar_growth_bound':'At most 2^(16*26000) before native factors; a declared constant, not an attained norm.',
